question: A baker made 120 cookies for a school event. she packed them into boxes, with each box holding 8 cookies. if she gave away 3 full boxes to the teachers and kept the rest for the students, how many cookies did the students get?
A bakery made 60 cupcakes for a party. one third of the cupcakes were chocolate, and half of the remaining cupcakes were vanilla. how many cupcakes were neither chocolate nor vanilla?

Maria is organizing a bake sale. she spends $18 on flour and $12 on sugar. each batch of cookies requires $3 worth of ingredients (not including flour and sugar). if she wants to make 10 batches, how much will she spend in total?
A farmer has chickens and sheep. chickens have two legs and sheep have four legs. if he has 18 chickens and twice as many sheep as chickens, what is the total number of legs all his animals have?
Samantha is organizing a school fundraiser. she buys 5 boxes of cookies at $6 each, 3 cases of juice at $8 per case, and 7 bags of chips at $2.50 each. how much does samantha spend in total?
A library has 150 books. each shelf can hold 10 books. if the librarian fills 8 shelves and donates the rest of the books to a school, how many books does the school receive?

A farmer has 15 apple trees, each producing 40 apples. he decides to plant 5 more trees, and each new tree produces twice as many apples as the original ones. how many apples will the farmer have after all the trees produce fruit?
Emily has 4 boxes of pencils. each box contains 15 pencils. she gives 18 pencils to her friends and then buys another box with 12 pencils. how many pencils does emily have now?

A movie theater sells tickets at $12 for adults and $7 for children. on a certain day, 8 adults and 15 children bought tickets to see a movie. how much money did the theater make from ticket sales that day?

A farmer harvested 360 apples from his orchard. he placed them into baskets, each holding 12 apples. if he sold 5 full baskets at the market and kept the rest for making cider, how many apples did he keep for cider?
A farmer has 48 apples. this is three times the number of pears he picked. if each apple weighs 6 ounces and each pear weighs twice as much, what is the total weight of all the fruit?

A bakery makes 9 trays of muffins, with each tray holding 16 muffins. if the bakery sells the muffins in boxes containing 6 muffins each, how many full boxes can they make, and how many muffins will be left over?

Samantha is planting flowers in her garden. she buys 5 packs of tulip bulbs, each containing 8 bulbs, and 3 packs of daffodil bulbs, each containing 10 bulbs. if she plants all the bulbs, how many flowers will samantha have in total?
A florist has 144 roses. she arranges them into bouquets, each containing 9 roses. if she sells 8 full bouquets and uses the rest to decorate her shop, how many roses did she use for decoration?

A baker made 5 trays of muffins, each tray containing 12 muffins. he also baked 3 trays of cupcakes, with each tray holding 8 cupcakes. if he sold all the muffins and cupcakes, how many baked goods did he sell in total?

Sarah has 5 boxes of crayons. she uses 60% of the crayons in two boxes and gives away 80% of the crayons in the remaining three boxes to her classmates. how many boxes worth of crayons does sarah have left, expressed as a percentage of a box?

Samantha is organizing a bake sale. she bakes 6 trays of cookies, with each tray holding 18 cookies. she sells 4 full trays at the sale and gives away the rest to her neighbors. how many cookies did samantha give to her neighbors?

Liam is organizing his bookshelf. he has 12 mystery novels and twice as many science fiction books as mystery novels. he also has 9 fewer fantasy books than science fiction books. if he donates all the fantasy books to the library, how many books does liam have left?
A movie theater has 12 rows of seats, with each row containing 18 seats. if a group books 7 full rows for an event, how many seats are still available in the theater after their reservation?
A school library has 500 books. one fifth of the books are fiction, and one quarter of the remaining books are biographies. how many books in the library are neither fiction nor biographies?

Nina bakes 3 batches of cookies every week, with each batch containing 18 cookies. her friend sam bakes twice as many batches per week, but each of his batches has only 12 cookies. how many more cookies does sam bake than nina in a week?
A bakery makes 12 loaves of bread each day. on mondays and wednesdays, they bake an extra 8 loaves. if the bakery is open 6 days a week, how many loaves do they bake in one week?

A gardener plants 8 rows of carrots, with each row containing 15 carrot plants. if rabbits eat 20 of the carrot plants and the gardener harvests half of the remaining carrots, how many carrot plants does the gardener have left after harvesting?

A school is organizing a field trip and rents buses to transport the students. each bus can carry 40 students. if there are 7 buses filled to capacity and 18 students left who need transportation, how many students are going on the field trip in total?

A bookstore received a shipment of 480 books. the staff arranged them onto shelves, with each shelf holding 16 books. if they sold 6 full shelves worth of books on the first day and kept the remaining books in storage, how many books are left in storage?

A library has 420 books to arrange on shelves. each shelf can hold 15 books. if the librarian fills 18 shelves completely and places the remaining books on a new shelf, how many books are placed on the last shelf?

A baker is preparing boxes of cupcakes for a party. each box holds 6 cupcakes. if he needs to prepare enough boxes for 54 guests, with each guest getting 2 cupcakes, how many boxes does the baker need to pack?
Olivia is planning a party. she spends $25 on decorations and $15 on snacks. each game she wants to set up costs $4 in supplies. if she plans to have 8 games, what will be her total spending?

Sarah is planting flowers in her garden. she plants 7 rows with 6 tulips in each row, and 5 rows with 8 daisies in each row. if she decides to give away 10 tulips and 12 daisies to her neighbors, how many flowers does sarah have left in her garden?

A school is organizing a field trip for 72 students. each bus can carry 18 students. if 2 buses are reserved for teachers and chaperones only, how many buses will be needed in total to transport all the students and adults?

A bakery makes 36 cupcakes every morning. on monday, they sell 15 cupcakes before noon and another 12 in the afternoon. in the evening, they bake an extra batch of 18 cupcakes. if they sold half of all the remaining cupcakes by closing time, how many cupcakes were left at the end of the day?
A bakery sells cupcakes for $3 each and cookies for $2 each. on a busy saturday, they sold 45 cupcakes and 60 cookies. how much total revenue did the bakery make from these sales?
A florist has 5 bouquets, each containing 12 roses. she uses 20 roses to decorate a wedding and then receives another bouquet with 10 roses from a friend. how many roses does the florist have now?

A florist is making bouquets using roses and lilies. each bouquet contains 4 roses and 3 lilies. she has 60 roses and 45 lilies available. if she makes as many complete bouquets as possible, how many flowers will she have left over?

Kevin is baking cookies for a bake sale. he makes 4 batches of chocolate chip cookies, each batch containing 15 cookies, and 3 batches of oatmeal cookies, each batch containing 12 cookies. if he gives away 10 chocolate chip cookies and 6 oatmeal cookies to his friends, how many cookies does kevin have left for the bake sale?
A florist is preparing bouquets for a wedding. she needs 5 roses, 3 lilies, and 2 tulips in each bouquet. if she makes 8 identical bouquets, how many flowers of each type does she need in total?

A farmer has 8 baskets, and each basket holds 14 apples. he decides to sell the apples in bags containing 5 apples each. after filling as many full bags as possible, how many apples will he have left over?

Maria is baking cookies for a school event. she bakes 5 trays with 12 chocolate chip cookies on each tray, and 4 trays with 15 oatmeal cookies on each tray. if she decides to pack 18 chocolate chip cookies and 20 oatmeal cookies into gift bags, how many cookies does maria have left?
A florist arranged 6 bouquets, each containing 9 roses. she also made 4 baskets, with each basket holding 7 lilies. if she sold all the bouquets and baskets, how many flowers did she sell in total?
A movie theater has 300 seats. for a special screening, they sold tickets for $12 each and filled 80% of the seats. how much money did the theater make from ticket sales for this screening?

Liam has 6 jars of marbles. he gives away half the marbles in four jars and adds 30% more marbles to each of the remaining two jars. how many jars worth of marbles does liam have now, expressed as a percentage of a jar?

A gardener planted 60 tulips, which is four times the number of daffodils she planted. if each tulip needs 2 cups of water per week and each daffodil needs three times as much, how many cups of water does she need for all her flowers in one week?

A school library has 500 books. during the first week, 120 books are borrowed by students. in the second week, 75 more books are checked out, but 60 books from the previous week are returned. how many books remain in the library at the end of the second week?
A baker has 5 trays of muffins, each tray holding 12 muffins. she bakes 3 more trays with 16 muffins on each tray. if she sells 48 muffins at the market, how many muffins does she have left?

A farmer harvested 200 apples from his orchard. he sold 60 apples at the market in the morning and gave away twice as many apples to his neighbors in the afternoon. if he used half of the remaining apples to make apple pies, how many apples did he have left?
A farmer has 4 chicken coops. each coop houses 12 chickens. every chicken lays 5 eggs per week. how many eggs does the farmer collect from all his chickens in one week?

A baker made 120 cupcakes. she arranged them in boxes, each holding 12 cupcakes. if she sold 7 full boxes and gave the remaining cupcakes to her neighbors, how many cupcakes did her neighbors receive?

A florist has 15 red roses and three times as many white lilies as red roses. she also has 8 fewer yellow tulips than white lilies. if she uses all the yellow tulips in a bouquet, how many flowers does she have left?

A movie theater sells tickets for $12 each. on saturday, they sold 45 adult tickets and 32 child tickets at $8 each. if the theater also made $150 from snack sales that day, what was their total revenue on saturday?

A pet store has 40 puppies and twice as many kittens. on monday, 15 puppies and 20 kittens are adopted. later that week, 10 more puppies arrive at the store, but 5 kittens are sent to another branch. how many animals does the pet store have at the end of the week?

A farmer has 24 apples and 36 oranges. he wants to pack them into boxes so that each box contains the same number of apples and the same number of oranges, with no fruit left over. what is the greatest number of boxes he can use?
Julia has 3 boxes of crayons, each containing 10 crayons. she buys 2 more packs, with each pack holding 12 crayons. if she gives away 18 crayons to her friends, how many crayons does julia have left?

A florist is arranging bouquets for a wedding. each bouquet requires 7 roses. if she needs to make enough bouquets so that each of the 9 tables gets 3 bouquets, how many roses does the florist need in total?

A bakery sells cupcakes in boxes of 8. if they prepare 7 boxes of chocolate cupcakes and 5 boxes of vanilla cupcakes, but 10 cupcakes from the total are damaged during delivery, how many undamaged cupcakes does the bakery have left to sell?

A bakery sells cupcakes for $3 each and cookies for $2 each. on a busy day, they sold 28 cupcakes and twice as many cookies. if the bakery also made $60 from drinks that day, what was their total revenue on that day?

A baker made 8 trays of cookies, each tray containing 12 chocolate chip cookies. she also baked 3 cakes, with each cake requiring 5 eggs. if she used all the cookies and cakes for a party, how many items did she bring to the party in total?

A gardener planted 120 tulip bulbs in her yard. she gave away 24 bulbs to a friend and used three times as many bulbs for a flower bed. if she decided to plant half of the remaining bulbs along the walkway, how many bulbs did she have left unplanted?

A farmer has 120 apples. he sells 30 apples in the morning and gives away half as many apples as he sold to his neighbors in the afternoon. in the evening, he picks 24 more apples from his orchard. if he eats a quarter of the remaining apples before going to bed, how many apples does he have left?

Sarah is organizing a bookshelf with 6 shelves. each shelf can hold 18 books. she fills up 4 shelves completely and then receives a gift of 15 more books, which she adds to the next shelf. after lending 10 books to her friend, how many books does sarah have on her bookshelf now?

A library has 12 shelves, each holding 25 books. if the librarian adds 3 more shelves and fills each new shelf with 40 books, but then donates 30 books from the total collection, how many books does the library have now?
